blocks: .boost { margin-top: 8px; height: 8px; background: rgba(25, 230, 255, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(25, 230, 255, 0.5); transform: skewX(-25deg); }
.boost i { display: block; height: 100%; width: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--c), #8ff7ff); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--c); }
.boost.on i { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--m), #ffc4f4); box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--m); }
@keyframes nitro-bar { from { filter: brightness(1); } to { filter: brightness(1.8); } }
